inputs.data/hook-bank.json: Hook bank for original hook text

validates: captions.json has captions array with 10+ entries
Each entry has: short_caption, medium_caption, linked_blueprint_id, platform, ready_for_qa
qa_rule: All outputs marked draft=true until qa_inspector exists
